title: REQUIREMENTS FOR SETTING REINSURANCE CONTACT OFFICE
text:
REPUBLIC OF GHANA
INSURANCE ACT, 2021 ACT 1061
REQUIREMENTS FOR SETTING UP REINSURANCE CONTACT OFFICE
1. A completed application form
2. A licence application fee of $25,000
3. A letter from jurisdiction regulator that applicant has a valid licence.
4. A copy of a valid licence to operate in Head Office
5. Curriculum vitae of Country/Office Manager
6. Curriculum vitae and other details of the company’s directors
7. Evidence of a bank deposit of GHS1,000,000 for the operations of the contact offices
8. A five (5) year business plan clearly showing the strategy of the contact office
CONDITIONS FOR THE MAINTENANCE AND OPERATION OF A CONTACT
OFFICE IN GHANA BY A REINSURER
1. The reinsurer shall hold at all times a deposit of an amount of USD 500,000 with an approved
Bank under lien in favour of the National Insurance Commission.
2. The reinsurer shall register with the Registrar General’s Department as an external company
doing business in Ghana.
3. The reinsurer shall engage Ghanaian nationals for their operations in line with the NIC
Corporate Governance and Risks Management Framework.
4. The reinsurer shall maintain a bank account in Ghana to allow tracking of remittances. The
account(s) will be subject to inspection by the Commission.
5. The reinsurer and the contact office will be required to file periodic returns with the
Commission as may be determined by the Commission.
6. The office should operate solely as a contact office. No business may be underwritten or
transacted by the office.

7. The contact office shall pay to the NIC, annual levy/licence fees to be determined by the NIC.
8. The reinsurer and the contact office shall comply with other conditions that may be issued by
the Commission from time to time.
9. The reinsurance company and its contact office shall comply with the Insurance Act 2021 Act
1061 and all relevant legal and regulatory directives and requirements.
